title: Volunteering at an animal shelter
instructions: Daniel hayvan barınağındaki gönüllü çalışmasını anlatıyor. Uzun bir metin; günleri, sayıları ve görevleri karıştırma. Bu sette 3 dinleme hakkın var.

script.speaker: daniel
script.text: For the last eight months, I've volunteered at an animal shelter near my town.

script.speaker: daniel
script.text: The shelter has about sixty dogs and forty cats. Most of them were found in the street.

script.speaker: daniel
script.text: I go every Saturday morning and on Wednesday evenings after work.

script.speaker: daniel
script.text: On Saturdays, I take the dogs for walks and clean their rooms.

script.speaker: daniel
script.text: On Wednesdays, I help in the office. I answer phone calls and take photos of the animals for the website.

script.speaker: daniel
script.text: Good photos are really important. People choose animals from the website.

script.speaker: daniel
script.text: Last month, twenty animals found new homes. That was a record!

script.speaker: daniel
script.text: The hardest part is saying goodbye. I really wanted to take a dog called Max home, but my flat is too small.

script.speaker: daniel
script.text: If you love animals, I really recommend volunteering. You don't need any experience.
